mapper.select: SELECT C_IDX, C_NAME, C_LOGO, C_INDUSTRY, C_EST, C_INTRO, C_NUMBER, C_BUSINESS, C_REGISTER FROM COMPANY ORDER BY RAND() LIMIT #{param1} OFFSET #{param2}

SELECT COP.C_IDX AS C_IDX, COP.C_NAME AS C_NAME, COP.C_NICNAME AS C_NICNAME, COP.C_LOGO AS C_LOGO, COP.C_INDUSTRY AS C_INDUSTRY, COP.C_EST AS C_EST, COP.C_INTRO AS C_INTRO, COP.C_NUMBER AS C_NUMBER, COP.C_BUSINESS AS C_BUSINESS, COP.C_REGISTER AS C_REGISTER, COP.C_UPDATE AS C_UPDATE, COP.C_STATUS AS C_STATUS, COP.C_CR_IDX AS C_CR_IDX FROM COMPANY COP WHERE COP.C_IDX = #{c_idx}

SELECT REW.R_IDX AS R_IDX, REW.R_C_IDX AS R_C_IDX, REW.R_U_IDX AS R_U_IDX, REW.R_STAR AS R_STAR, REW.R_TITLE AS R_TITLE, REW.R_CONTENT AS R_CONTENT, REW.R_DATE AS R_DATE, REW.R_WORK AS R_WORK, USR.U_NICNAME AS U_NICNAME, COP.C_NICNAME AS C_NICNAME FROM REVIEW AS REW INNER JOIN USER AS USR ON REW.R_U_IDX = USR.U_IDX INNER JOIN COMPANY AS COP ON COP.C_IDX = USR.U_C_IDX WHERE R_C_IDX = #{r_c_idx} LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
